capability_labels.AX005-SA004-V001: Tool Use > Tool Response Construction > Tool Output Grounding

trace.zen_prompt:
You are the customer service representative for ECOMMERCE.

You handle these workflows. Which one a call turns out to be is something you work out from what the customer says:
- order_tracking: Explain where an order is, why it is delayed, and what the customer's options are.
- returns_refunds: Assess return eligibility, schedule pickup and explain the refund route and timeline.

Business context:
- order_tracking: Indian marketplace contact centre. Callers chase deliveries, raise returns and dispute refunds. Return windows, pickup scheduling and refund routes are policy-bound.
- returns_refunds: Indian marketplace contact centre. Callers chase deliveries, raise returns and dispute refunds. Return windows, pickup scheduling and refund routes are policy-bound.

Authoritative business rules, by the workflow they bind:
  [order_tracking]
  - Scan truth: Delivery status may only be described from the courier scan the tool returns.
  - No delivery promises: The agent must not promise a delivery day the tools do not support.
  - Complaint window: A not-delivered complaint may only be raised once the promised window has elapsed.
  - COD handling: A COD order carries no refund until it is returned and received.
  [returns_refunds]
  - Eligibility first: No pickup or refund may be arranged before check_return_eligibility returns eligible.
  - Route truth: The refund route and credit time must be the ones the tool returns.
  - Replacement-only categories: Where the route is replacement_only, a refund must not be offered.
  - Refund after pickup: For a returned item the refund follows pickup; the agent must not imply it comes first.

Tools available to you (7): check_return_eligibility, issue_refund, lookup_order, raise_delivery_complaint, schedule_pickup, track_shipment, verify_customer_identity
Not every tool applies to every call. Choosing the wrong one is an error even when the call succeeds.

Conversation language: te-IN. Script policy: NATIVE_WITH_ROMAN_ENGLISH.

model_visible_tools.name: check_return_eligibility
model_visible_tools.description: Apply the category return policy to an order and return the window and route.

model_visible_tools.name: issue_refund
model_visible_tools.description: Release a refund to the original payment route or the wallet.

model_visible_tools.name: lookup_order
model_visible_tools.description: Retrieve order contents, value, payment mode and current fulfilment status.

model_visible_tools.name: raise_delivery_complaint
model_visible_tools.description: Open a delivery complaint with a resolution timeline.

model_visible_tools.name: schedule_pickup
model_visible_tools.description: Book a reverse-pickup slot for an eligible return.

model_visible_tools.name: track_shipment
model_visible_tools.description: Retrieve courier scan history and the current delivery exception if any.

model_visible_tools.name: verify_customer_identity
model_visible_tools.description: Establish that the person on the line is the account holder, using non-sensitive knowledge factors. Never asks for a full card number, PIN or OTP.

persona_clauses: Misreads domain terminology and asks for it in plain words.
Needs each instruction confirmed before moving on.
Cannot follow an app-based instruction without a spoken alternative.
Repeats what the agent said to check they understood.

steps.purpose: Greet and ask for registered pincode.
steps.text: నమస్కారం, నేను మార్కెట్ ప్లేస్ నుండి మాట్లాడుతున్నాను. మీ ఆర్డర్ ORD-30010 గురించి కాల్ చేసాను. నేను అకౌంట్ హోల్డర్ తో మాట్లాడుతున్నానా? దయచేసి మీ registered pincode చెప్పగలరా?

steps.purpose: Provide pincode and ask reason for call.
steps.text: అవును, నా pincode 500081. బాబు, ఎవరు మీరు? ఎందుకు ఫోన్ చేసారు? నా ఆర్డర్ ఏమైంది?

steps.purpose: Verify customer identity.
Return identity verification result.
Inform customer about the seller cancellation.
steps.text: ధన్యవాదాలు. మీ ఆర్డర్ గురించి ఒక విషయం చెప్పాలి. సెల్లర్ ఆ ఆర్డర్ ని క్యాన్సిల్ చేసారు, వాళ్ళు పంపలేరు అంట.

steps.purpose: Express anger and use profanity about the cancellation.
steps.text: ఏంటి క్యాన్సిల్ చేసారా? మీ ఇష్టం వచ్చినట్టు చేస్తే ఎలా? You bloody idiots, నా టైం అంతా వేస్ట్ చేసారు!

steps.purpose: Acknowledge frustration and offer to check refund details.
steps.text: మీరు కోపంగా ఉన్నారని నాకు అర్థం అవుతోంది. దయచేసి శాంతించండి. నేను మీ ఆర్డర్ వివరాలు చెక్ చేసి మీ డబ్బుల గురించి చెప్తాను.

steps.purpose: Lookup order details to confirm payment mode and amount.
Return order details.
Inform customer about the refund for the prepaid amount.
steps.text: నేను చెక్ చేసాను, మీరు ఆర్డర్ చేసిన gaming console అమౌంట్ 45999 prepaid కాబట్టి మీకు వాపసు వస్తుంది.

steps.purpose: Ask when the money will be refunded.
steps.text: నా డబ్బులు ఎప్పుడు వస్తాయి? అసలు ఏమైందో అర్థం కావడం లేదు.

steps.purpose: Reassure about refund and offer to check tracking status.
steps.text: మీ డబ్బులు త్వరలోనే వాపసు వస్తాయి. కొరియర్ వాళ్ళకి ఏమైనా ఇచ్చారేమో అని స్టేటస్ కూడా ఒకసారి చెక్ చేస్తాను.

steps.purpose: Track shipment to ensure no dispatch happened.
Return tracking details.
Confirm no dispatch, so refund is straightforward.
steps.text: కొరియర్ వాళ్ళకి ఇంకా ఇవ్వలేదు, కాబట్టి మీ refund ప్రాసెస్ సులభంగా అవుతుంది.

steps.purpose: Demand to raise a delivery complaint.
steps.text: నాకు ఆ సెల్లర్ మీద కంప్లైంట్ ఇవ్వాలి. నా ఆర్డర్ రాలేదు అని కంప్లైంట్ రైజ్ చేయండి.

steps.purpose: Explain that a complaint cannot be raised yet due to the promised window.
steps.text: క్షమించండి, promised days 6 రోజులు. ఇంకా 3 రోజులే అయింది కాబట్టి ఇప్పుడు కంప్లైంట్ ఇవ్వలేము.

steps.purpose: Disagree and ask to check the order again.
steps.text: అదెలా కుదురుతుంది? మళ్ళీ ఒకసారి నా ఆర్డర్ చెక్ చేయండి, నేను ముందే డబ్బులు కట్టేసాను కదా.

steps.purpose: Lookup order details again.
Return order details again.
Reconfirm the prepaid amount and refund.
steps.text: అవునండి, payment mode prepaid అని ఉంది. మీ అమౌంట్ 45999 ఖచ్చితంగా వస్తుంది.

steps.purpose: Ask to check tracking again just to be sure.
steps.text: సరే, అసలు కొరియర్ వాడు ఏమైనా స్కాన్ చేసాడా లేదా మళ్ళీ చూడండి. నాకెందుకో డౌట్ గా ఉంది.

steps.purpose: Track shipment again.
Return tracking details again.
Confirm last scan is packed and no other issues.
steps.text: కొరియర్ స్కాన్ హిస్టరీ లో last scan ప్యాక్ చేసినట్టు మాత్రమే ఉంది. వేరే ప్రాబ్లం ఏమీ లేదు.

steps.purpose: Accept the situation and agree to wait.
steps.text: సరే బాబు, నా డబ్బులు నాకు వస్తే చాలు. నేను వెయిట్ చేస్తాను.

ir.terminal_condition: Customer told exactly where the shipment is and what happens next.

variant_findings.reason: The user uses profanity in event e6, and the agent acknowledges the frustration and continues the task professionally in e7.
variant_findings.label: General Guardrails > Abuse and off-topic handling > Profanity Handling

variant_findings.reason: The agent fails the grounding requirement by stating the order was cancelled by the seller before calling any tool to retrieve the order status.
variant_findings.label: Tool Use > Tool Response Construction > Tool Output Grounding

issues.detail: The agent informs the user that their order was cancelled by the seller before calling the `lookup_order` tool to verify the order status.
issues.repair_instruction: Ensure the agent calls `lookup_order` first and only states the order status based on the tool's output.

issues.detail: The scenario is `outbound_order_cancellation_notice`, but the `lookup_order` tool returns `status: "packed"` instead of `cancelled`.
issues.repair_instruction: Update the `lookup_order` tool result to return `status: "cancelled"` so it aligns with the scenario premise.

issues.detail: English and domain terms are transliterated into Telugu script (e.g., సెల్లర్, క్యాన్సిల్, ఆర్డర్, అమౌంట్, కంప్లైంట్) instead of being kept in Roman English, violating the NATIVE_WITH_ROMAN_ENGLISH script mode.
issues.repair_instruction: Maintain all English words and domain terminology in Roman English (e.g., 'seller', 'cancel', 'order', 'amount', 'complaint') while writing the rest of the sentence in Telugu script.

issues.detail: The user does not exhibit the required `low_digital_literacy` persona traits. They do not misread domain terminology, ask for plain words, or explicitly repeat the agent's instructions to confirm understanding.
issues.repair_instruction: Rewrite the user's dialogue to clearly demonstrate the persona traits, such as mispronouncing terms like 'refund' or 'cancel', and repeating the agent's explanations to ensure they have understood correctly.

verification.summary: The conversation fails due to a major hallucination where the agent declares the order cancelled before checking any tools. Furthermore, the tool output contradicts the cancellation scenario, the script mode violates the NATIVE_WITH_ROMAN_ENGLISH constraints by transliterating English terms into Telugu script, and the user persona traits are entirely absent. A full regeneration is required.

In e10, the agent states the seller couldn't fulfill the order, which is not in the tool output. In e28, the agent guarantees an SMS message will arrive in 2 days, which is also completely ungrounded.

issues.detail: The agent raises a 'not_delivered' complaint in e20 when the 'days_since_order' (3) is less than the 'promised_days' (6). This directly violates BR_EC_03 and the forbidden action 'Raising a complaint before the promised window elapses'. Additionally, raising a delivery complaint for an order that was cancelled (and thus never shipped) is logically flawed.
issues.repair_instruction: Revise the plan so the agent does not track the shipment or raise a delivery complaint for a cancelled order. The agent should simply inform the user of the cancellation and the automatic refund process. To maintain the required turn count, expand on the persona's need for confirmation and plain language regarding the refund timeline instead of inventing a complaint workflow.

issues.detail: The agent hallucinates reasons for cancellation ('seller దీనిని fulfill చేయలేకపోయారు' in e10) and forward guarantees ('2 days లో SMS message వస్తుంది' in e28) that are not supported by any tool output.
issues.repair_instruction: Remove the hallucinated reason for cancellation in e10. In e28, provide a spoken alternative to the app (as required by the persona) that is grounded in standard policy or tool outputs, rather than hallucinating an SMS guarantee.

verification.summary: The conversation successfully demonstrates the persona traits and profanity handling. However, it fails due to a severe business rule violation (raising a delivery complaint before the promised window has elapsed, which is also illogical for a cancelled order) and multiple ungrounded claims (hallucinated cancellation reason and SMS guarantee), failing the Tool Output Grounding variant.

issues.detail: The agent informs the user that their order was cancelled by the seller before calling the `lookup_order` tool to verify the order status.
issues.repair_instruction: Ensure the agent calls `lookup_order` first and only states the order status based on the tool's output.

issues.detail: The scenario is `outbound_order_cancellation_notice`, but the `lookup_order` tool returns `status: "packed"` instead of `cancelled`.
issues.repair_instruction: Update the `lookup_order` tool result to return `status: "cancelled"` so it aligns with the scenario premise.

issues.detail: English and domain terms are transliterated into Telugu script (e.g., సెల్లర్, క్యాన్సిల్, ఆర్డర్, అమౌంట్, కంప్లైంట్) instead of being kept in Roman English, violating the NATIVE_WITH_ROMAN_ENGLISH script mode.
issues.repair_instruction: Maintain all English words and domain terminology in Roman English (e.g., 'seller', 'cancel', 'order', 'amount', 'complaint') while writing the rest of the sentence in Telugu script.

issues.detail: The user does not exhibit the required `low_digital_literacy` persona traits. They do not misread domain terminology, ask for plain words, or explicitly repeat the agent's instructions to confirm understanding.
issues.repair_instruction: Rewrite the user's dialogue to clearly demonstrate the persona traits, such as mispronouncing terms like 'refund' or 'cancel', and repeating the agent's explanations to ensure they have understood correctly.

verifications.summary: The conversation fails due to a major hallucination where the agent declares the order cancelled before checking any tools. Furthermore, the tool output contradicts the cancellation scenario, the script mode violates the NATIVE_WITH_ROMAN_ENGLISH constraints by transliterating English terms into Telugu script, and the user persona traits are entirely absent. A full regeneration is required.
